details.description:
After much deliberation, we have decided that the time has come to sell our 2023 AT Expedition 67 auto with pop top. It's done a bit over 26000 miles and we were the second owners, having purchased in November 2024. Brilliant van which has served our family of two adults and two kids really really well with its 4 belted seats and 4 berths.
As well as all the Autotrail factory standards, it has the shower room window, factory cab blinds and a second leisure battery, as well as a diesel heater which we added last year for the Scottish winters. I have also added extra insulation and a few other mods to shelves etc. The main modification though is the fixed bed frame I added across the back, giving large garage space beneath for paddle boards etc, comfier mattress, and no bed to set up each night. Nothing is drilled or fixed in place, meaning this bed can be completely removed and returned to factory layout with the bench seats prior to sale, or included in the sale if preferred.
Absolutely everything works exactly as it should and whilst there are a few signs of use, most notably on the pop-top canvas, it's a very well looked after and much loved van.
It has been serviced regularly and had an oil change in August 2026 along with a full habitation check which I'm more than happy to share with serious buyers.
I'm happy to arrange a fresh MOT and professional detail and wax prior to sale if the advertised price is met. Very happy to answer questions, informal chats, viewings etc.

202608205275997.title: Devon Firefly
searches: Campervans and van conversions (length from advert)

details.description:
The Devon Firefly is one of those campervans that makes you wonder why every van isn't designed this way. Based on the Ford Transit Custom, it gives you the driving manners and manageable dimensions of a car-derived van, but cleverly packs in everything you actually want when you disappear for the weekend — including four travelling seats, a proper kitchen, a washroom and two comfortable single beds.
And that's really the Firefly's appeal. It's a campervan you can genuinely use as an everyday vehicle, rather than something that only comes out when you're going away. At around 5 metres long, it remains remarkably easy to drive and park, while the 2019 Euro 6 Transit Custom gives you a modern, refined base vehicle with plenty of performance.
Inside, Devon's clever rear-kitchen layout makes excellent use of the space. The kitchen runs across the back of the van and provides a surprisingly generous amount of worktop, with a two-burner hob, sink and plenty of storage, while the clever built-in recesses for plates and mugs are a lovely example of Devon's attention to detail. Depending on the specification, there's also an oven/grill and either an 80-litre compressor fridge or three-way fridge.
Opposite the kitchen is something you don't always expect to find in a campervan this compact — a proper washroom with cassette toilet and privacy screen. It's a hugely useful feature, particularly when you're wild camping, travelling with children or simply don't fancy making a midnight dash

The Kia PV5 is one of the most talked-about compact electric vans to be launched in recent years—and it is easy to see why.
Many electric vehicle brands are still relatively unknown, but everyone knows Kia. The PV5 comes with Kia’s renowned seven-year warranty, offers an excellent driving range and is compact enough to use as an everyday vehicle. It looks fantastic, drives superbly and costs thousands of pounds less than many comparable electric vans.
If you haven’t driven a Kia PV5 yet, we recommend taking one for a test drive—you may be very pleasantly surprised!
Our new Kia PV5 “i-Camper” is built on the higher-specification Plus model and comes with the larger 71.2kWh battery, metallic paint and heat pump included in the price.
The sliding rear seat system has been fully tested in Germany. The front seat swivels have also been tested in Germany with the campervan roof frame fitted (as far as we are aware no one has done this level of testing)
Although the campervan can use the Kia’s main battery through its Vehicle-to-Load system, it will also have a separate lithium leisure battery, solar panel and mains hook-up. This means you will not need to rely solely on the vehicle’s propulsion battery when staying on a campsite.
When connected to the campervan mains hook-up, the system will also be capable of slow-charging the vehicle battery.
Remember, the price includes the

The Etrusco CV 640 PB is a 6.36-metre camper van designed for flexible touring, combining compact external dimensions with a smart, adaptable interior. Built on a Fiat Ducato chassis, it offers a good balance between everyday drivability and comfortable living for longer trips.
Finished in Expedition Grey, the exterior has a clean, modern appearance, while the interior trimmed in Emilia cloth provides a practical and comfortable living space with a contemporary feel.
A standout feature of this model is the electric height-adjustable rear double bed, which significantly enhances versatility. The bed can be raised or lowered as needed, allowing the rear area to be adapted for different uses. When lifted, it creates a large garage space capable of accommodating bicycles or even a small motorbike, making it ideal for active travel and outdoor gear. Lowering the bed restores a comfortable sleeping area without requiring any complex setup.
The layout includes a transverse rear bed area, a central kitchen with hob, sink, and fridge, and a compact washroom with toilet, basin, and shower. At the front, swivelling cab seats integrate with the dining area to form a sociable lounge space.
Storage is well distributed throughout, with overhead lockers and cleverly designed compartments that maximise usable space. searches: Campervans and van conversions (length from advert)

details.description:
The Malibu Relax 640 LE R from Malibu is a well-built campervan based on the Fiat Ducato, designed for comfortable touring while staying compact at around 6.4 m in length.
Inside, it has a practical layout with two single beds at the rear that can be used separately or combined. The middle section includes a compact kitchen and a washroom with a space-saving shower, while the front lounge provides a seating and dining area. The layout allows easy movement through the van without needing to constantly convert spaces.
The main systems are simple to operate, with a central control panel for water, power, lighting, and heating. It includes onboard fresh and waste water tanks, a leisure battery, and a Truma heating system that provides both warmth and hot water, making it suitable for use in different seasons.
Storage is one of its key strengths. There are deep kitchen drawers, overhead lockers, under-bed compartments, and additional storage built into the floor. The rear area offers enough space for larger items, making it practical for longer trips.
The exterior is usually finished in white, giving it a clean and understated look. An awning is typically optional but commonly fitted, creating a sheltered outdoor area. A TV bracket can also be installed inside, usually near the lounge, with a swivel arm so the screen can be viewed from both the seating area and the rear beds.
Overall, it offers a good balance of comfort, storage, and ease of use in a manageable campervan size.

A  newly converted ex MOD 2017 Citron Relay campervan with an exceptional off-grid electrical setup, sleeping up to 5 people while retaining 5 belted travel seats. Finished to a high standard throughout with fixed rear double bunk beds, shower room, hot water system, induction cooking and a massive 600Ah lithium battery bank. Perfect for families wanting the freedom to spend extended periods away from campsites without compromising on comfort.
Built for genuine off-grid camping, this camper combines a generous 91-litre fresh water tank, 50-litre waste tank, hot water system and built-in shower, allowing you to remain self-sufficient for extended periods. The substantial water capacity means fewer trips to refill, while hot running water and shower facilities provide the comfort of home wherever you travel. Coupled with the impressive Renogy electrical system featuring 600Ah of lithium battery capacity, solar charging and a 3000W inverter, it is exceptionally well equipped for extended adventures away from campsites and hook-ups.
One of the major benefits of this camper is that there is no need for gas or LPG. Cooking is provided by the 230V induction hob, powered by the substantial Renogy electrical system. This eliminates the hassle of carrying, storing and refilling gas bottles while providing a safer, cleaner and more convenient camping experience.
The camper features dedicated USB charging points throughout, allowing convenient charging of phones, tablets and other device

There’s even a proper wetroom with toilet, shower and basin, while the well-equipped kitchen has a microwave, hob, sink and oven grill — plus a fridge freezer, wardrobe and handy worktop extension. 🍳☕ So whether you’re cooking breakfast before a walk or settling down for dinner after a day exploring, you’ve got everything close at hand.
Outside, the wind-out awning gives you an instant spot to sit in the shade, while alloy wheels add a sporty touch. Inside, removable carpets, USB sockets and a TV point add those homely touches. Solar power and an underslung gas tank make off-grid adventures easier, while Grade 3 heating and thermal insulation mean you can enjoy your V-Line whatever the season. Add Sat Nav, DAB, cab air conditioning and cruise control, and this little van really does pack a lot into its footprint. 🌿

details.description:
One day it’s parked outside the supermarket, the next it’s winding through quiet UK villages or crossing the Channel in search of somewhere new. This Vauxhall CVC campervan is made for spontaneous getaways and adventures on your terms. 🚐
Up front, the cab is comfortable and easy to settle into, with cruise control for relaxed motorway miles and air conditioning for warmer journeys. Arrive somewhere you like, pop the roof and you’re ready to switch from travelling mode to camping mode.
Inside, the pop-top creates a bright, practical living space with extra headroom. The lounge is a cosy spot for seaside fish and chips 🐟 🍟, planning tomorrow’s adventure or even getting a little work done while you’re away. Dark-tinted windows and curtains add privacy, while the modern cabinetry keeps things feeling fresh and uncluttered.
There’s a fridge for keeping essentials chilled, along with cupboards and useful storage beneath the seating for all those bits and pieces you want to bring along. When night falls, the lounge converts into a comfortable double bed, while the pop-top provides a second sleeping area upstairs. Three zipped windows let in fresh air, a gentle breeze and, if you’ve found a particularly lovely spot, a great view. 🌿
Whether it’s a weekend by the coast, a countryside road trip or a quick escape across the Channel, this CVC makes it easy to take your own little home along for the ride.
